title: RepliClaw live action-set manifest (one problem)
description: Freeze-time, single-source-of-truth action manifest for one registered AIOpsLab mitigation problem. Both intervention-matched arms (D-E centralized, C-EQ) MUST draw their admissible action vocabulary, budget cap, escrow->action mapping and reset digest exclusively from this file, so tool parity holds by construction. Validatable with a stock JSON-Schema validator (jsonschema); no custom dependencies.

pinned_repo_sha.description: AIOpsLab upstream commit the action surface was read from. Frozen: ccf08d0d1d5fa5b30f120e2e8549662d44411b35.

app.description: AIOpsLab Application this problem deploys (SocialNetwork / HotelReservation / AstronomyShop).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the app (and thus the fault + digest) is scoped to.

action_set.description: The EXACT admissible intervention/observation action vocabulary for this problem, read from the code's registered action registry (aiopslab/utils/actions.py get_actions('mitigation')). Arm-identical: both arms receive this list.

changed_factors.description: Which environment dimension(s) the action perturbs (RepliClaw InterventionSpec.changed_factors analogue). 'cluster_state' = the write/intervention channel; 'observation' = read-only; 'episode_termination' = submit. Both arms read the same factor names so selection is matched on the factor menu, not the outcome.

arm_visible.description: Whether this action is exposed to BOTH arms (true) or one arm only (false). For matched-tools parity every admissible action is arm_visible=true; false is reserved for a pre-freeze, pre-registered gating decision and must be documented in the design doc.

params.description: Optional frozen signature/param constraints, e.g. exec_shell timeout=30.

max_steps.description: Frozen per-trial step cap passed to Orchestrator.start_problem(max_steps). AIOpsLab itself imposes NO per-problem cap (start_problem just loops range(max_steps), service.py default is 10); this value is a RepliClaw freeze decision. Arm-neutral: the SAME integer is passed to both arms' start_problem, so the cap cannot bias one arm.

function_id.description: Deterministic escrow-selection -> action_id function. Chosen over a hash: the frozen action_set IS the table; a selection resolves by identity lookup of the action_id (or its 0-based ordinal in action_set) into this manifest. Arm-identical by construction, fully auditable, no truncation/ambiguity.

seed.description: Reserved seed. Unused for the explicit-table path; used ONLY by the D-R (random-selection) comparator to seed uniform selection FROM the same admissible action_set, so D-R stays inside the matched vocabulary.

resources.description: Post-reset resources snapshotted to prove the environment returned to baseline before each trial. Namespace-scoped workload objects + PVs for this app.

hash_algorithm.description: Digest algorithm over the canonical (sorted, compact JSON) serialization of the enumerated resource list for the problem namespace (+ PVs by name). sha256 for cross-platform stability (matches RepliClaw canonical_bytes/sha256 convention).

canonicalization.description: Serialization rule: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) per resource, concatenated in the fixed order of `resources`.

required.description: true = this problem requires a human-approved, VM-backed deployment before any live trial (hotel-reservation / astronomy-shop). Never fake their state: no live run until approved.

gates.description: What the gate controls, e.g. 'VM provisioning + paid run for test-hotel-reservation / astronomy-shop namespaces'.

excluded_actions.description: AIOpsLab actions that are NOT mappable to a matched intervention vocabulary, each with a reason. Single source of truth so both arms exclude the same surface.
